integrity: The argument is an exact deduction from explicitly identified published lemmas and theorems. No numerical experiment is used to establish the infinite claim, and no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The equivalence is proved only for real parameters. It does not settle the complex-parameter necessity direction of the strong-PV discreteness conjecture. The original 1985 paper was not full-text inspected; its two needed statements were verified through explicit restatements in later full-text sources.
title: Sparsity forces strong-PV structure for every real parameter
